title: Gurman: Apple to announce its touchscreen MacBook on October 27
description: Yesterday, a report claimed that Apple is planning two separate product launches this month. While the company has confirmed the first event, scheduled for October 13, Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman has now revealed when the second launch could take place. According to Gurman, who cites sources familiar with Apple’s plans, the second launch is scheduled for Tuesday, October 27, or around that date. title: iQOO Neo12's display could be very special
description: The iQOO Neo11 came out in October of last year, so it's pretty much time for its successor to show up any day now. According to a new rumor from Digital Chat Station on Weibo, the iQOO Neo12 may be packing a very unique screen. Chinese display panel maker Visionox is said to be working on an OLED panel with "2K" resolution and a 185Hz refresh rate, which will be the world's first mass-produced screen to pair those two specs. description: Xiaomi launched the Redmi Turbo 5 Max earlier this year with a 9,000mAh battery and a 6.83-inch display. Now, a new rumor suggests that its successor, the Redmi Turbo 6 Max, could feature an even larger battery and display. Tipster Digital Chat Station has revealed that an upcoming mid-range smartphone powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 9500s chipset will feature a large display (around 7-inch) and a battery with a capacity exceeding 10,000mAh. title: Another vivo V80 is coming, certification reveals
description: A few days ago, vivo launched the V80, which follows in the footsteps of the V80 Lite that got official last month. But the V80 series isn't done yet - there's (at least) another member of the family on the way. Indonesia's SDPPI has certified a vivo phone with the model number V2624 under the name vivo V80 FE. Unfortunately, the certification doesn't reveal any specs or any details about the phone whatsoever, aside from its name and model number. Xiaomi smartphone owners will be able to share photos, files, contacts, and web pages with an iPhone. Even better, HyperOS 4 will let users view cloud photo albums on either smartphone. There are also real-time notifications and instant message replies across the two ecosystems thanks to two-way sync. title: Amazon Kids Tablets are now official in two sizes
description: Today Amazon has unveiled two tablets aimed at kids, and they're unsurprisingly called the Amazon Kids Tablets. They are available in 8.7" and 11" sizes, with two distinct models, one made for ages 3+, the other for ages 6+. The 8.7-inch tablet has 64GB of storage and its battery lasts for up to 14 hours of video playback, while the 11" model has "a beautiful 2.5K display" and 8GB of RAM. title: The OLED MacBook Pro may not be much thinner than the current model
description: Apple's long-rumored OLED MacBook Pro, which will be its first laptop with a touchscreen, may not end up being much thinner than the current model, according to Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman. He has thus contradicted his own previous predictions, now saying that he doesn't think "it'll be significantly thinner in the end". For reference, the current MacBook Pro 14" is 15.5mm thick and weighs between 1.55kg and 1.62kg, while the 16-inch model is 16.8mm thick and weighs between 2.14kg and 2.15kg. So there's definitely a lot of room to make the new ones lighter, and perhaps slightly thinner...

description: Amazon first got into the tablet game with the Kindle Fire. It later dropped the “Kindle” branding to emphasize that its tablets do more than its e-readers. And now the company is changing tack again with the introduction of the Amazon Alexa tablets. As you can tell from the name, AI is a big part of this. However, the change in naming also emphasizes that these are fully-featured Android tablets – Fire tablets were known for being cheap but good enough (and did we mention cheap?). description: According to a new rumor, the iPhone Air 2, expected to launch next spring alongside the iPhone 18 and iPhone 18e, will be even thinner than its predecessor. How thin? 5.2mm. title: Report: Samsung is cutting up to 30% of its smartphone production in Q4
description: The ongoing memory chip crisis has been plaguing tech companies for months and a new report from Korea’s Money Today suggests that Samsung is ready to significantly cut its smartphone production as a result. According to the report, Samsung Mobile Experience (MX) has already reached out to suppliers to reduce their production volumes by 20-30%. This is specifically for the Q4 months (i.e October-December) and according to estimates, Samsung is now expected to cap off the year with around 200 million smartphone shipments instead of the previously estimated 270 million figure. description: After unveiling the Find X10 series in China last month, Oppo has now confirmed when the phones will launch in global markets. description: Samsung Electronics has announced its earnings guidance for the third quarter of 2026, covering July to September. Samsung said its consolidated sales for the period were approximately KRW 195 trillion ($145.33 billion), while consolidated operating profit was approximately KRW 107.40 trillion ($80 billion). description: Announced at Computex earlier this year, the Microsoft Surface Laptop Ultra is finally available for pre-order. title: Everyone can now check if an image, video, or audio file was made with AI
description: Starting today, Google is making its SynthID Detector tool available to everyone across the globe in English. This tool can be used to find out if an image, video, or audio file was made with AI from Google, OpenAI, Nvidia, or Kakao. Soon, the SynthID Detector will also detect media that was created with Apple's AI tools. For its part, Google says it's watermarked over 180 billion images and videos and "240,000 years of audio content" with SynthID since it was launched in 2023.
